requirements.statement: Audit rows 14–15 are addressed by a portable verification and extracted-package contract that removes creator-machine command dependencies and classifies command resolution deterministically.

Audit rows 16–17 are addressed by foundational version, compatibility, bootstrap, and migration-state interpretation needed before later installation/distribution work, without implementing the installer.

Audit row 30 is addressed by an explicit framework/consumer artifact boundary that prevents consumer, generated, machine-local, historical, and runtime state from leaking into a distributable KEEL package.

Audit rows 39–40 are addressed by portable reproducibility and supply-chain/attestation foundations within the bounded P0 scope, with unavailable runtime/provider evidence classified rather than guessed.
The repository-owned bootstrap manifest producer deterministically regenerates declared generated state and records producer provenance without hand edits.
